proposed_engineering_defaults.note: Configurable proposal, not a contest rule or measured performance guarantee.

expected_semantics: Verify credential, topic and registered identity; heartbeat may be from an unbound registered device.
Never-seen is unknown. Persist fresh authenticated heartbeat before treating last_seen as established.
Same message_id redelivery must not extend last_seen repeatedly; retained or stale replay cannot revive connectivity.
Use receiver UTC time for last_seen, not device-provided sent_at. Check send-time validity/freshness for this software simulator.
At server elapsed >= configured offline_after_seconds, persist one offline transition; repeated scans do not create duplicate events.
Fresh heartbeat after offline produces one new recovery source_event_id linked to the original offline event.
Connectivity does not establish measurement quality, warehouse binding or normal cold-chain risk.

invalid_examples.expected: retryable failure, do not claim persisted heartbeat

implemented_component: Pure heartbeat validation and immutable offline/recovery transition plans; see heartbeat.py. A plan is not persistence.
